name: The House of Wonder
verdict: Candlelit French fine dining, made for long romantic dinners. Make sure to try the seafood.
description: Walk in under the painted ceiling and the room does the rest. Tables are lit by small red lamps, the banquettes are deep, and nobody hurries you.
The kitchen cooks classic French food with a light hand. Start with the shellfish, share a whole fish or the côte de boeuf, and leave room for the soufflé.
Book the corner tables for two. Ask for the room at the back if there are eight of you.
order: The shellfish to start, a whole fish to share, then the soufflé.
hours: Dinner, Tuesday to Saturday, 6pm to midnight
bestTable: The corner banquettes, directly under the painted ceiling.
when: Book the late sitting. The room is at its best after nine.
dress: Smart. Jackets welcome, trainers less so.

name: Scott's
verdict: The grand seafood room on Mount Street. Sit at the oyster bar and order as much as you dare.
description: A Mayfair institution with a terrace that is always full and an oyster bar that is the best seat in the house.
order: Oysters at the bar, then the Dover sole.

name: Fallow
verdict: Clever, generous cooking from an open kitchen. Go with friends and order widely.
description: A lively room with counter seats facing the chefs. The menu changes often and rewards the curious.
order: Corn ribs and the mushroom parfait.

name: House of Ming
verdict: Sichuan and Cantonese cooking in a jewel box of a room. Book the private dining room for a celebration.
description: Green silk walls, a crystal chandelier and a menu that moves between Sichuan heat and Cantonese finesse.
order: Dim sum to start, then the Sichuan dishes.

name: Saltie Girl
verdict: Lobster rolls, towers of shellfish and a long list of tinned fish. Cheerful and unstuffy.
description: A bright seafood bar where the lobster roll is the order and the tinned fish list is worth exploring.

name: Otto's
verdict: Old-school French theatre at the table. Order ahead for the pressed duck.
description: Red velvet, silver presses and a host who runs the room. Dishes are finished at the table with real ceremony.
order: The pressed duck, ordered in advance.

name: Delamina
verdict: Bright, generous plates to share. Good for a long catch-up.
description: A relaxed neighbourhood room serving Eastern Mediterranean dishes built for the middle of the table.
order: A spread of small plates for the table.

name: Bar Wonder
verdict: A low-lit bar for the first drink of the night. The martini is poured at the table.
description: Small, dark and quiet enough to talk. Arrive early for a seat at the bar.
bestTable: The two stools at the end of the bar.
when: Before dinner, while it is still quiet.

name: The Night List
verdict: Where the evening goes after dinner. Loud, late and very good fun.
description: A basement bar with a short cocktail list and a DJ from ten. Tables are held for members.
order: A round of the house cocktails.
station: Tottenham Court Road, four minutes' walk

name: The Wonder Rooms
verdict: Twelve rooms, an honesty bar and breakfast until noon. The quietest night's sleep in town.
description: A townhouse hotel on a residential street. Rooms at the back look over the garden.
bestTable: Ask for a room at the back, over the garden.
